title: Issue 841 D6: Ledger integrity
context: Owner decision recorded in Eliyce/paqad-ai issue 841, row D6: Every row gets an `idempotency_key` and a `prev_hash`. Appends take a per-bundle lock (atomic `mkdir`, wait up to 200 ms, then read the last line, append, `fsync`, release). If the lock is not won in time, append anyway with `prev_hash: null` and `chain_note: "lock-timeout"`. The completeness gate verifies the chain and reports a declared gap as a warning, never a failure. The ledger never blocks a hook.
